patch_description: This version combines the general 14-point diameter-normalized optimization from the current program with a structured antipodal line-packing initialization inspired by the crossover program. It uses deterministic multi-start annealed pairwise forces, retains the best exact ratio seen during all runs, and performs several focused perturb-and-refine passes around the strongest configuration. The antipodal starts add geometrically meaningful diversity while the unrestricted 14-point optimizer can escape the lower-quality antipodal family.
